notes: Comparison of seven wild-type laboratory/biotech strains, aerobic vs anaerobic, no treatment. No strain is named as the reference, so is_control left out. genotype_class reference given to every strain as an unmodified collection strain (BL21(DE3) carries DE3 and DH5a is a lab mutant, but the study does not perturb them). Crooks: strain_group not stated, left out. Anaerobic cultures in sealed bottles with glucose and no electron acceptor named -> anaerobic_fermentation (inferred). Aerobic samples in shaken flasks.
